description_en: Queries snapshot information by calling DescribeSnapshots
kebab_example: aliyun ens describe-snapshots --ens-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --snapshot-id sp-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --ens-region-ids cn-suzhou-telecom_,_cn-chengdu-telecom --snapshot-name testSnapshotName --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSnapshots

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS edge zone. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637662.html to query edge zone IDs
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the specified cloud disk
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.help_en: The snapshot ID. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 snapshot IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 快照标识编码。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: The array of ENS edge zone IDs. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.name: ens_region_ids

parameters.help_en: The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: snapshot_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current query
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the current query

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。按照[ISO8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss

EnsRegionId.description_en: The ID of the ENS edge zone

SnapshotName.description_en: The display name of the snapshot. This field is returned if a display name was specified when the snapshot was created
SnapshotName.description_zh: 快照显示名称。如果创建时指定了快照显示名称，则返回

SourceDiskCategory.description_en:
The disk type. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: all-flash cloud disk.
local_hdd: local HDD.
local_ssd: local SSD
SourceDiskCategory.description_zh:
磁盘类型。取值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：全闪云盘。
local_hdd：本地HDD盘。
local_ssd：本地盘SSD

SourceDiskId.description_en: The ID of the source cloud disk. This field is retained even if the source cloud disk of the snapshot has been released
SourceDiskId.description_zh: 源云盘ID。如果快照的源云盘已经被释放，该字段仍旧保留

SourceDiskType.description_en:
The disk property. Valid values:

1: system cloud disk.
2: data cloud disk
SourceDiskType.description_zh:
磁盘属性。取值：

1：系统盘。
2：数据盘

SourceEnsRegionId.description_en: The ID of the source ENS edge zone

SourceSnapshotId.description_en: The ID of the source snapshot

Status.description_en:
The snapshot status. Valid values:

creating: The snapshot is being created.
available: The snapshot is available.
deleting: The snapshot is being deleted.
error: An error occurred
Status.description_zh:
快照状态。取值：

creating：创建中。
available：可用。
deleting：删除中。
error：错误
